name: One Possible Future
source: One Possible Future is an adult visual novel that explores a path humanity and AI could take: a sci-fi world in which humans want for nothing, and their every need is met by robot caretakers.
translation: One Possible Future is an adult visual novel that explores a path humanity and AI could take: a sci-fi world in which humans want for nothing, and their every need is met by robot caretakers.
